dogecoin.text:
All set for a #bullrun!
#Dogecoin whale activity surges to new all-time highs.

Source of news : #santiment https://t.co/te75SEFw4d

On-chain data shows that some of the largest #Dogecoin wallets are selling their holdings at an alarming rate.

Whales holding 10-100M Doge have sold more than 570M coins last week, according to data from #Santiment, which could be a sign of severe #volatility in the coming week. https://t.co/v7PMKcABK6

Last week, #PEPE rose by a whopping 68% to $0.000015, outperforming its rivals #Dogecoin & #ShibaInu.

This rise coincided with BTC’s rise above $105K, boosting the market value of #memecoins to $76.13B.

Pepe is now trading at $0.00001314, having corrected 7% in the past 24 hrs. https://t.co/Oq6nN6CnOJ

The upward trend in #Dogecoin has caught the attention of analysts by breaking through the 200-day moving average, and has raised the scenario of the biggest growth in 2025 for the #memecoin.

The next target for #DOGE is the resistance of $0.25, which was last seen in early May. https://t.co/pFrISJQCwm

The #Dogecoin price has risen 42% in the past 7 days.

On-chain data also shows that net inflows of #DOGE into exchanges have been negative in recent days. This indicates an increase in investor willingness to hold and a decrease in selling pressure in the market. https://t.co/Uiq1NLY8rT
